messages:
ella_cs: Heads-up: SunRidge Health onboarding flagged contract SLO for latency (p99 <= 320ms). During their bulk record ingest last night we observed p99 spikes ~370ms for embeddings. Need triage, a comms draft, and a credit estimate. @diego_sre @harper_fin @mina_legal @sam_ae

diego_sre: Looking now. Can you give the windows? My initial thought: batching + cache misses during large ingest. I can run a replay with KV prefix caching and limit concurrency.

ella_cs: Two windows: 01:22-01:28 and 02:45-02:50 UTC. Sample metrics:
```
01:24:10 POST /v1/embeddings p99 372ms host:dedicated-eu-1
- db read 105ms; model decode 230ms; queue wait 37ms
02:46:11 POST /v1/embeddings p99 368ms host:dedicated-eu-1
- cache miss; db 100ms; model decode 228ms; batching 40ms
```

sam_ae: FYI they're up for renewal in ~11 weeks. Procurement will likely ask about remediation. Keep credit conservative and couple with remediation timeline.

harper_fin: Contract usually has banding. Proposed quick bands for discussion:
- p99 <= 320ms: 0%
- 320ms < p99 <= 360ms: 3% goodwill
- 360ms < p99 <= 420ms: 5% goodwill + remediation plan
- p99 > 420ms: escalate to legal + 10% cap
I can convert to dollars if we confirm monthly committed spend.

mina_legal: Please paste the SLA clause before we propose numbers externally. We should avoid wording that implies a platform-wide outage. Use "latency variance during scheduled onboarding imports" and frame credits as "goodwill per contract terms." Also confirm whether credits are automatic or need approvals.

diego_sre: Low-risk mitigations: 1) enable short TTL prefix KV caching for import jobs, 2) cap import concurrency to 4 workers, 3) route interactive sessions to the low-latency model variant. I'll run a replay tonight and post delta.

ella_cs: Proposed actions: 1) @diego_sre run caching+cap replay and post results by 08:30 UTC, 2) @harper_fin compute $ for 3%/5% bands once I post monthly invoice, 3) @mina_legal confirm comms language, 4) I'll draft the external note to SunRidge including mitigations + proposed credit (aim: 10:00 TOM).

harper_fin: Found their monthly committed spend: $27,000. Rough numbers:
- 3% = $810
- 5% = $1,350
I'll prepare a short spreadsheet for the customer note.

mina_legal: Tone approved. Recommend the customer note include: a) brief summary of observed variance, b) immediate mitigations applied, c) proposed goodwill credit with cap, and d) timeline to re-evaluate in 14 days. Avoid terms like "failure".

sam_ae: I'll ping the exec sponsor and procurement lead to signal proactive handling. Could also present a Dedicated capacity upsell if they want more headroom — outline cost delta if they ask.

diego_sre: Replay results (ran 01:22 window with cache+cap): p99 dropped from ~372ms -> ~312ms; queue wait reduced ~35ms -> ~12ms. Will run second window replay at 07:00 and post.

ella_cs: Great — please post second replay numbers and I'll assemble the customer note for sign-off. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
